query: What are the accepted COVID-19 vaccinations for entry into Singapore?
reference_answer: Travellers are strongly encouraged to be vaccinated with COVID-19 WHO EUL vaccines. There are currently no requirements related to COVID-19 vaccines for entry to Singapore You may refer to the Entering Singapore page for full details on entry requirements.
answer: The accepted COVID-19 vaccinations for entry into Singapore include those from the World Health Organization's Emergency Use Listing (EUL). These typically include vaccines from manufacturers like Pfizer-BioNTech, Moderna, AstraZeneca, and Janssen. [Document 1]
